scope: AWS DevOps Agent original solution model declarations, named model dictionaries and separate selected native SDK shape catalog.
countingRules: The fixed benchmark is the 34 distinct class/ER symbols independently extracted from the eight original ER diagrams (D01–D07 and U02); sequence/workflow actors are excluded.

A source symbol belongs to exactly one catalog concept; only genuine name/case aliases are combined. Native Task and application Investigation remain distinct, as do generic SourceRevision and journal-specific JournalRecordRevision.

Named identity, semantic-entity and API-wide model dictionary concepts supplement the diagram benchmark. Ordinary fields, every possible graph category, asset-type value and operation are not counted as new entities.
originalEntityDeclaration records an explicit source class/entity declaration; sourceSemanticKind states what that construct means. Neither says it must become a target entity.
The 52 selected native SDK structures/unions form a supplementary resource/value/wrapper universe and must not be added to business-entity counts. Their exact heading names are audited separately.
NORMALIZED means an essential typed entity/value/profile binding preserves the source concept; it does not claim all optional native members or complete SDK-schema conformance.
RETAINED_ONLY means a named registered profile preserves source evidence, but payload JsonValue and observedFields text are not a typed normalized model.

PARTIAL means a typed core exists but an essential source distinction or explicit source contract member is absent/narrowed; gaps name the limit. UNMAPPED would mean no substantiated target representation.
All statuses describe proposed contracts. No production adapter, runtime enforcement or customer data coverage has been demonstrated.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SPACE.
constructs.previousUse: The native workspace scopes tasks, executions, journal records, associations and assets. It is not the application tenant.
constructs.identity: Owning partition/account/Region + agentSpaceId; ARN is an alias.
constructs.coverageReason: AgentSpace provides a typed scoped entity and association collection with exact selected observation. Peripheral provider configuration remains in its retained Source.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ASSOCIATION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D01 — workspace, association and external reference

constructs.previousUse: A native space-scoped integration association carries its own ID, configuration discriminator and optional registered-service relation. Built-in serviceId aws does not require a registration.
constructs.identity: Owning AgentSpace + associationId; serviceId is not unique within the space.
constructs.coverageReason: AgentAssociation is a typed owned value in each AgentSpace version with associationId, serviceId, configurationKind, optional registration identity and exact source. Demotion to an owned value preserves its source identity; native configuration remains Source-backed.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: REGISTERED_SERVICE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D01 — workspace, association and external reference

constructs.previousUse: Provider integration registration supplies service type, accessible resources, connection configuration and native registration lifecycle; it may resolve an association.
constructs.identity: Owning partition/account/Region + registered serviceId.
constructs.coverageReason: A named registration profile retains the provider record; no normalized registration value/entity or management contract exists. It is correctly kept distinct from workload Service.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: TASK.
constructs.previousUse: A native backlog work item has scoped identity, task type, status, priority, native version, optional execution pointer and external/primary-task references. The native catalog contains multiple task types.
constructs.identity: Owning scope + AgentSpace + taskId.
constructs.coverageReason: The INVESTIGATION task facet has a typed entity with identity/status/version and scoped links. EVALUATION, RELEASE_READINESS_REVIEW and RELEASE_TESTING tasks remain retained Task documents; priority and other native header fields are read through the retained source.
gaps: Only the INVESTIGATION discriminator is normalized as an application aggregate; the native Task family is broader.
constructs.notes: Task and Investigation share a registry mapping row, but the source defines Task as a native resource and Investigation as an application composition over one task type.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: INVESTIGATION.
constructs.previousUse: An application composition over an INVESTIGATION Task, observed execution memberships, journals, phase results and historical captures.
constructs.identity: Investigation continuity follows the scoped native Task identity; related execution/result/capture records retain their own identities.
constructs.coverageReason: The aggregate is represented by Investigation plus explicitly referenced executions, journal evidence, result projections and snapshots. It is not claimed to be a native AWS Investigation response.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: EXTERNAL_REFERENCE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D01 — workspace, association and external reference

constructs.previousUse: A Task embeds an external ticket/incident reference with system, reference ID, URL and association ID; association resolution can remain absent historically.
constructs.identity: An owner-local reference to external system + referenceId and association context.
constructs.coverageReason: ExternalReference is a typed owned value with the native linkage members and nullable resolvedAssociationId; loss of the current association does not erase the reference.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: EXECUTION.
constructs.previousUse: Native execution with explicit parent hierarchy, subtask and execution state; task membership is observed separately and STOPPED does not imply success.
constructs.identity: Owning scope + AgentSpace + executionId.
constructs.coverageReason: Execution preserves identity, parent identity, state, subtask and exact observation. Optional native agent/session metadata remains source-backed rather than guessed.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: TASK_EXECUTION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D02 — native core with an explicit membership table

constructs.previousUse: Records a task-scoped ListExecutions request/response association because Execution does not contain a taskId and global one-task ownership is not established.
constructs.identity: Scoped task/investigation + execution pair, with retained observation of the association.
constructs.coverageReason: The owned membership value links canonical Investigation and Execution IDs to an exact Observation. An Execution has no mandatory single investigation parent.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: JOURNAL_RECORD.

evidence.heading: The native envelope is the reliable base

constructs.previousUse: Published native envelope with space/execution/record ID, open recordType, createdAt and arbitrary JSON content, including unknown record types.
constructs.identity: Owning scope + AgentSpace + executionId + recordId.
constructs.coverageReason: JournalRecord normalizes the envelope identity/type and exact source/observation references. Keeping content as retained arbitrary JSON is faithful to the native contract, not a missing universal hypothesis schema.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: RECORD_REVISION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D02 — native core with an explicit membership table

constructs.previousUse: Retains a distinct observed journal payload/envelope rendition when content changes under the same native record ID; it does not assert a native journal revision API.
constructs.identity: Source journal identity + retained rendition; old model used a local revision ID and payload hash.
constructs.coverageReason: Journal history is represented by exact versions of stable Source and JournalRecord identities, with separate observation occurrences. No version-only entity is needed.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SOURCE_OBJECT.

evidence.heading: Diagram D03 — every projection retains provenance

constructs.previousUse: The stable logical object behind retained journal, task/execution, event, stream or asset representations.
constructs.identity: Complete scoped source/channel/native key, independent of content digest and observing credentials.
constructs.coverageReason: Source owns stable sourceId and a typed complete SourceIdentity; source operation and representation are part of its logical key. Observing credentials do not redefine native ownership.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SOURCE_REVISION.

evidence.heading: Collection observations are separate from source revisions

constructs.previousUse: Generic immutable retained rendition for a source object, distinct from occurrences of reading or receiving it.
constructs.identity: Stable scoped Source identity + entity version; old model used revision_id and declared content hash.
constructs.coverageReason: Source versions preserve the retained rendition and digest profile, while Observation records repeated receipts. A changed A→B→A sequence advances normal versions instead of reviving an old rendition ID.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: PROJECTION_SOURCE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D03 — every projection retains provenance

constructs.previousUse: A citation connects one derived rendition to an exact retained source, optionally at one of several distinct fragments in that source.
constructs.identity: Owning derived rendition + exact source version + locator; no independent lifecycle is required.
constructs.coverageReason: EvidenceRef pins kind/id/version and EvidenceLocator supplies JSON pointer, asset path or text-range attribution. Distinct locators remain distinct citations without another entity.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: DERIVED_REVISION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D03 — every projection retains provenance

constructs.previousUse: Immutable rendition of a logical timeline item, finding, result document or graph assertion, retaining item kind, assertion origin, payload and derivation identity.
constructs.identity: Stable logical item + immutable rendition; old model used projectionRevisionId separately.
constructs.coverageReason: Ordinary Projection versions normalize five result profiles. Other DevOps renditions are retained as application-origin Source documents; the generic prior item-kind/assertion-origin contract is not a normalized Projection variant.
gaps: Projection.profile is closed to five variants; timeline/assertion/action-observation variants do not exist.
The normalized Projection envelope has no assertionOrigin field.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: DERIVATION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D03 — every projection retains provenance

constructs.previousUse: The parser and rule/model version that produced a derived rendition, with explicit distinction between native fields, deterministic parsing, operator assertions and inference.
constructs.identity: Owner-local immutable derivation identity/version; a new parser must not rewrite an old result.
constructs.coverageReason: Projection retains profileVersion and ruleDigest, which identify the selected computation. The source contract’s explicit derivation kind/assertion origin and separate parser/model metadata are not a typed owned Derivation shape.
gaps: No typed normalized assertion-origin/derivation-kind member distinguishes direct provider mapping, operator statement and application inference.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: GRAPH_SNAPSHOT.

evidence.heading: Diagram D04 — graph snapshot and typed edges

constructs.previousUse: A captured application graph with named graph meaning and immutable node/edge renditions. Execution, task-link, evidence, topology, causal and configuration graphs have different evidentiary semantics.
constructs.identity: Graph/capture identity + immutable rendition; endpoints are owned by the same graph snapshot.
constructs.coverageReason: Snapshot(kind=TOPOLOGY) binds GraphContents with typed nodes/edges. The foundation preserves capture identity, but the original graph contract’s explicit node kinds and richer provenance/unresolved-state semantics remain incomplete.
gaps: GraphContents.graphKind offers four broad values; named execution, task-link and configuration view meanings are not explicit variants.
GraphNode/GraphEdge omit several source-required semantics; see their rows.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: GRAPH_NODE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D04 — graph snapshot and typed edges

constructs.previousUse: Snapshot-owned graph node with kind, exact source/projection references, label, assertion origin, validity/observation context and explicit unresolved-placeholder state.
constructs.identity: Graph snapshot + node ID; a placeholder is not a fabricated resource.
constructs.coverageReason: GraphNode normalizes nodeKey, optional exact entity/source identity, label and evidence. It does not explicitly model node kind, assertion origin or a marked unresolved-node state.
gaps: No nodeKind, assertionOrigin or unresolved-state member exists on GraphNode; null references alone cannot distinguish all these meanings.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: GRAPH_EDGE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D04 — graph snapshot and typed edges

constructs.previousUse: Snapshot-owned typed relation with same-snapshot endpoints and evidence; parentage, support/contradiction, temporal order, dependency and asserted causality retain different meaning.
constructs.identity: Graph snapshot + edge ID; source and target join nodes in that same snapshot.
constructs.coverageReason: GraphEdge preserves endpoint keys, relationKind, claimKind and exact evidence, but its PROVIDER/DERIVED/HYPOTHESIS claim vocabulary is narrower than the prior explicit assertion-origin/validity contract.
gaps: Operator-confirmed versus independently observed versus application-inferred provenance and optional published confidence/disposition are not normalized edge fields.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: RESOURCE_REF.
constructs.previousUse: An explicitly published resource identifier or URL with namespace/type provenance and resolution state; association access does not prove incident implication.
constructs.identity: Qualified external provider/resource identity or an explicit provisional reference.
constructs.coverageReason: SourceIdentity, canonical Resource identity/matches and optional graph sourceIdentity preserve qualified or provisional references. The normalized link remains evidence-backed rather than inferred from shared workspace location.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ARTIFACT_REF.
constructs.previousUse: Application discovery/presentation reference spanning native Asset files, journal/stream inline or external content and A2A artifacts without equating their IDs.
constructs.identity: Source channel + exact record/block/locator + optional native artifact or Asset-version identity.
constructs.coverageReason: ArtifactRef supplies a managed durable locator, content version/digest and availability, while AssetFile and EvidenceRef supply related context. There is no one normalized value carrying the prior source-channel/record/block/native-ID/optional-asset-resolution contract.
gaps: A2A versus journal versus native Asset identity and inline/external resolution are not explicit ArtifactRef members.
Availability values collapse several source distinctions such as not-yet-published, access-denied, unsupported and deleted.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ASSET.
constructs.previousUse: Native AgentSpace asset with open type, metadata, versioned content and owned files; an asset in the same space is not automatically an investigation input or output.
constructs.identity: Owning scope + AgentSpace + assetId.
constructs.coverageReason: Asset has stable identity and ordinary entity versions with separate nativeVersion, exact source and files. Provider metadata stays retained; no inferred investigation-to-asset relation is introduced.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ASSET_VERSION.

evidence.heading: Diagram D05 — investigation references and native asset history

constructs.previousUse: A specific native asset version used for reproducible metadata/content/file reads, distinct from an unversioned latest read.
constructs.identity: Scoped native Asset + provider assetVersion.
constructs.coverageReason: Each ordinary Asset representation selects the exact native version and its files/source. Native version remains domain metadata rather than a new Version entity; old Asset representations remain readable.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ASSET_FILE.

evidence.heading: Diagram D05 — investigation references and native asset history

constructs.previousUse: A file belongs to an exact native Asset version and exact path, with text/bytes content, metadata and timestamps retained from the native response.
constructs.identity: Scoped Asset + native Asset version + exact case-sensitive path; no independent file version counter.
constructs.coverageReason: AssetFile is a typed owned path/source/artifact value under the selected Asset representation. Raw body union and native file metadata remain source-backed, and the Asset nativeVersion supplies ownership.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SNAPSHOT.
constructs.previousUse: An explicit retained capture closes over task/version, membership, journal/source renditions, selected results, supporting read/coverage records and capture interval.
constructs.identity: Application capture ID scoped to the investigation; later continuation does not alter an earlier capture.
constructs.coverageReason: Snapshot is a deliberate business capture with immutable versions, exact closed members, coverage and capture bounds. Its purpose is not a substitute for versioning the captured entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SNAPSHOT_SOURCE.
constructs.previousUse: Links the snapshot to the exact retained source and supporting collection/coverage versions used in the capture.
constructs.identity: Owner Snapshot version + exact referenced entity kind/ID/version.
constructs.coverageReason: Snapshot.members contains exact EntityRef values and the closure rule includes supporting ReadAttempts/evidence. Later successful collection cannot improve an older capture.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SNAPSHOT_PROJECTION.
constructs.previousUse: Pins an exact derived rendition and hash within a snapshot so a parser upgrade cannot replace the result previously reviewed.
constructs.identity: Owner Snapshot version + exact Projection representation, or exact retained Source for imported legacy renditions.
constructs.coverageReason: Exact Snapshot members pin Projection versions; imported legacy rendition content is pinned as Source versions. This replaces the old projectionRevisionId without creating a separate rendition entity.
constructs.notes: The registry preservation text still uses obsolete sourceRevisionIds/projectionRevisionId terms; the actual schema uses members containing EntityRef values.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: COLLECTION_PASS.

evidence.heading: Collection observations are separate from source revisions

constructs.previousUse: One bounded investigation reconciliation attempt with start/end, fixed queries, collector version and selection policy; owns read attempts including empty/failed reads.
constructs.identity: Workspace + pass identity with fixed investigation/query scope.
constructs.coverageReason: Collection preserves stable identity, fixed query set, connection, lifecycle and time window. Its normalized record does not retain the prior explicitly required collector version or selection-policy identity.
gaps: Collection and CollectionQuery have no collectorVersion or selectionPolicy/version field.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: READ_ATTEMPT.

evidence.heading: Collection observations are separate from source revisions

constructs.previousUse: A scoped operation/page attempt exists even when no objects are returned or when the request fails; retains exact request/response/tokens, outcome and authorization context.
constructs.identity: Collection + attempt identity; retries have their own attempt/order metadata.
constructs.coverageReason: ReadAttempt has typed identity, lifecycle, timestamps, provider request ID, counts/errors and exact request/nullable response Source references. Empty success and lost response remain distinct.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: SOURCE_OBSERVATION.

evidence.heading: Collection observations are separate from source revisions

constructs.previousUse: One occurrence of reading/receiving a retained source rendition, separated from the rendition so repeated unchanged polls remain observable.
constructs.identity: Observation occurrence ID with exact Source version and optional native read-attempt context.
constructs.coverageReason: Observation is a separate typed entity carrying exact source, occurrence time, channel, connection and optional read attempt. Non-read channels do not manufacture native attempts.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: COVERAGE_CLAIM.

evidence.heading: Collection observations are separate from source revisions

constructs.previousUse: A bounded claim about what one pass established for a named query, based on page-chain/read-attempt evidence and evaluation policy; exhaustion is not global completeness.
constructs.identity: Owning collection/projection/capture version + query/window/scope + policy and supporting attempts.
constructs.coverageReason: Coverage normalizes independent pagination/detail/resolution/identity/claim dimensions, exact attempts, scope/window, evaluation time and rationale. It does not carry an explicit evaluation-policy identity/version, particularly when owned by Collection or Snapshot.
gaps: Coverage has rationale but no typed policy/rule version; only Projection has ruleDigest at its owner level.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: APPROVAL_REQUEST.
constructs.previousUse: An observed paused-invocation request ties an approval ID to exact execution, interrupt/tool-use IDs and requested tool/argument scope; it is a validated open-content profile, not a universal native ApprovalRequest structure.
constructs.identity: Scoped AgentSpace + approval ID and invocation context; request identity must not be guessed from prose or button labels.
constructs.coverageReason: ApprovalRequest normalizes execution, nativeApprovalId, state, exact request source, action digest and decision/resume command links. Invocation interrupt/tool-use IDs and the requested pattern remain inside Source.payload, with descriptor-level profile hints.
gaps: No typed model fields for interruptId, toolUseId or requested ApprovalPattern; the application must validate the retained request profile before commands.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: DECISION_ATTEMPT.
constructs.previousUse: Records a distinct approval/rejection submission with requested action, finalized scope hash, actor and definitive or ambiguous outcome; decision is separate from resume.
constructs.identity: Application decision intent/attempt identity scoped to the exact approval request.
constructs.coverageReason: Command and CommandAttempt normalize durable identity, authenticated actor, request digest, dispatch/reconcile state and observed evidence. DecideApproval supplies typed decision input, but the readable Command representation lacks an exact retained request/decision field.
gaps: A requestDigest identifies intent but does not reconstruct the original APPROVED/REJECTED action or finalized pattern; no Command.requestSource/request value is exposed.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: RESUME_ATTEMPT.
constructs.previousUse: A separately observed resume submission follows a definitive decision; opening a stream does not prove tool resumption or success.
constructs.identity: Application resume intent/attempt identity plus the exact prior decision context.
constructs.coverageReason: ResumeExecution binds exact ApprovalRequest and successful decision Command versions; Command owns its intent, lifecycle and observed effects separately from the decision. Contract semantics enforce the decision reference and ambiguous-outcome boundary.
constructs.notes: The exact decision input is present in ResumeExecutionRequest; the Command read model is a summarized receipt rather than the full input payload.

constructs.declarationReason: Declared as a class/ER model construct: ACTION_OBSERVATION.
constructs.previousUse: An independently sourced observation of request, approval, resume, tool execution or effect; permission or credential redemption alone does not prove success.
constructs.identity: Application observation/rendition ID with exact request/command/source context and stage.
constructs.coverageReason: The named LOCAL_EVIDENCE source profile retains an action-stage rendition. No normalized ActionObservation value or Projection profile exists; generic Observation denotes receipt occurrence, not this stage/outcome view.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: Qualifies native ownership using partition, account and Region; a reading principal or connected resource account is not necessarily the native owner.
constructs.identity: Partition + owning account ID + Region; service-specific parent keys qualify native IDs.
constructs.coverageReason: OwningScope is a typed owned identity value and SourceIdentity retains provider/service/resource type plus native or provisional identity. It is separate from credentials.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: Application access path plus authorization context qualifies collection, caching and historical exports without changing native identity.
constructs.identity: Application connection ID + authorization-context identity.
constructs.coverageReason: Connection and exact connection references preserve the access path, while attempts/observations retain the authorization-context key. Historical retrieval is checked against current authority.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: A separately sourced EventBridge lifecycle event supplies phase, event time, task/execution links and sometimes an exact summary pointer; it is not a journal entry.
constructs.identity: Event channel + account/Region + native event ID.
constructs.coverageReason: The lifecycle-event profile retains the full envelope and Observation carries channel/time. InvestigationResult normalizes selected completion-pointer meaning, not the complete lifecycle-event DTO.
constructs.notes: This named source identity-table concept has a registered profile but no direct mapping alias in the legacy 174-row crosswalk.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: A retained response or content block has request/session scope and supplied response ID, index, block ID, parent or sequence; unresolved IDs and interrupted fragments remain explicit.
constructs.identity: Execution + local request/session + supplied response/block identifiers; not a JournalRecord key.
constructs.coverageReason: The STREAM Source profile and receipt Observation retain the original event/fragment. There is no normalized assembled response/block model or replay cursor.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: A versioned application timeline rendition with stable item identity, phase/category, evidence/record/observation clocks, provenance, availability, explicit grouping and supersession.
constructs.identity: Investigation + stable logical item ID + immutable rendition.
constructs.coverageReason: The dedicated source profile retains an earlier TimelineItem document. Projection.profile has no timeline variant and there is no TimelineItem value definition; its time/phase/assertion fields are not normalized.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: A published incident-relevant observation or conclusion. An exact journal/summary fragment or validated structured field.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized Finding value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: A measurement, log excerpt, query result, trace reference, change record or external document. Source record/path and original system/time range when explicitly provided.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized EvidenceItem value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: An asserted possible explanation with its published disposition. A validated payload or attributed extraction; no reconstruction of private reasoning.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized Hypothesis value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: The agent or operator’s stated causal assessment. An exact cited conclusion kept separate from independent verification.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized RootCauseAssessment value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: Proposed action steps, target scope and prerequisites. Published proposal content; approval or execution must not be inferred.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized MitigationProposal value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: A quality review of the published investigation record. Explicit review content/source/scope; no assumed universal native ReviewResult schema.
constructs.identity: Application logical assertion/result item + retained rendition and source attribution.
constructs.coverageReason: The assertion LOCAL_EVIDENCE profile retains the attributed source rendition. There is no normalized ReviewResult value or Projection variant; the generic payload and descriptor text do not establish a typed result contract.
constructs.notes: This DevOps concept is not an alias of the resilience module’s Finding, Recommendation or ResilienceAssessment entities.

constructs.declarationReason: Explicitly named application/native entity or application record in the model dictionary.
constructs.previousUse: A versioned selected rendering/summary with phase, exact source revision, parser version and selection reason; completion-pointer absence is distinct from a retrieval gap.
constructs.identity: Investigation + result phase/logical view + immutable interpretation version.
constructs.coverageReason: INVESTIGATION_RESULT binds InvestigationResult: selected/candidate sources, expected summary identity, phase, completion observation, availability and selection basis. Projection version/profileVersion/ruleDigest retain interpretation history.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: Optional native journal attribution containing supplied userId and userType IAM/IDC/IDP; absent attribution does not identify an internal agent.
constructs.identity: Owner JournalRecord source + supplied user identity/provider type.
constructs.coverageReason: Native userReference survives only in the retained journal Source. JournalRecord has no attribution field, and ActorRef describes a trusted acting principal with different fields and enum semantics.
gaps: The registry’s ActorReference representation label has no normalized binding that preserves native userId/userType.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: Native conversation-execution summary used for interactive chat history selection, with execution ID, created/updated time and optional summary.
constructs.identity: Space/session collection context + executionId; no assumed identity equivalence to a task’s execution membership.
constructs.coverageReason: The conversation profile retains ChatExecution output; no normalized chat-execution view or conversation history model is defined.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: A native pending-queue item with message ID and user/assistant message union, not a complete conversation archive.
constructs.identity: Queue/session scope + native messageId.
constructs.coverageReason: Pending message data remains inside the conversation Source profile; queue membership is not converted into durable normalized conversation history.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: The native response EventStream union covers response lifecycle, content block start/delta/stop, summaries and heartbeats with variant-specific optional IDs and sequence.
constructs.identity: Native request/session plus the supplied event/response/block identifiers; not a global durable event ID.
constructs.coverageReason: The registered stream capture profile retains union branches and unknown variants, but its observedFields are descriptors rather than an executable normalized union schema.

constructs.declarationReason: Named model value, source channel, resource-family configuration or transport view; not an independently declared entity class.
constructs.previousUse: Native requested/finalized approval scope consists of a tool and pinned argument map; finalization may match or narrow the request, never widen it.
constructs.identity: Owned scope value for the exact approval request/decision context.
constructs.coverageReason: Approval context and digest are modeled, but the tool/argumentPins shape has no model definition or direct typed member. It remains in retained source content for adapter validation.

findings.title: Registry rows and aliases do not count independent entities

evidence.heading: Diagram D02 — native core with an explicit membership table
Diagram D03 — every projection retains provenance

findings.finding: The registry groups Task/Investigation and generic/journal-specific revisions as aliases, while the source assigns them different native/application or specialization roles. The 52 SDK shapes additionally contain many nested values and wrappers.
findings.recommendation: Count the 34 independently extracted class/ER symbols as a fixed declaration benchmark, retain a separate semantic concept catalog, and show native resources, values and wrappers in separate subtotals.

findings.title: Timeline and richer investigation assertions are retained, not normalized projections
findings.finding: Named source profiles exist, but each has descriptive typedContent text, not a normalized result schema. Projection.profile is closed to five profiles and only INVESTIGATION_RESULT covers a dedicated DevOps result shape.
findings.recommendation: Keep retention explicit in the coverage total. Promote a concrete supported use case through an owned typed result and registered Projection profile with exact provenance; do not introduce one new entity or revision entity per assertion kind.

findings.title: Native journal attribution is not an ActorRef binding
findings.finding: The crosswalk labels UserReference as an owned ActorReference, but JournalRecord has no attribution member and ActorRef is the trusted command actor {issuer,subject,kind}. Native userId/userType survives only in raw journal payload.
findings.recommendation: Correct the crosswalk to retained-only until a distinct owned native-attribution value or explicit reviewed identity mapping is defined. Do not infer an actor when native attribution is absent.

findings.title: Graph structure exists but required graph meaning and provenance are incomplete
findings.finding: The model preserves owned endpoint keys, relationKind and evidence, but lacks an explicit node kind, assertion origin and unresolved-placeholder state. The source also distinguishes more graph-view meanings and provenance/validity facts than the current closed graphKind/claimKind fields.
findings.recommendation: Add only the owned graph fields needed by supported graph views and retain exact evidence, rather than treating every graph node as a new canonical entity. Test an unresolved placeholder and an operator-asserted causal edge as semantic cases.

findings.title: Approval context is pinned but invocation and scope values remain raw
findings.finding: ApprovalRequest pins source/digest and nativeApprovalId, but interruptId, toolUseId, tool and argumentPins are only described by a source profile. No ApprovalPattern/ApprovalAction owned model value exists. The original source itself warns that approval request content is not a universal native typed entity.
findings.recommendation: Define and validate the particular observed request profile before dispatch. If typed normalized access is needed, add an owned invocation/scope value with field-presence semantics; preserve request source/digest and keep decision, resume and effect separate.

findings.title: Collector and coverage-policy identity are not retained as typed metadata
findings.finding: The source CollectionPass contract includes collector version/selection policy and CoverageClaim retains evaluation policy. Current Collection/CollectionQuery/Coverage capture query, window, attempts, dimensions and rationale but no explicit versioned collector/policy binding.
findings.recommendation: Represent collector/evaluation policy identity as a small owned binding on the appropriate collection/coverage owner, or explicitly defer it. Do not treat free-text rationale as an exact policy version or add policy-version entities.

findings.title: Generic artifact storage descriptors do not fully normalize cross-channel artifact references
findings.finding: Managed artifact locators, asset files and exact evidence locators are typed, but the original ArtifactReference carries channel/record/block/native-ID/optional-asset-resolution semantics and finer unavailability reasons that are not a single current owned value.
findings.recommendation: Keep the source reference inspectable and state this as partial normalization. Add a channel-aware owned reference only when a concrete inline, A2A or native Asset use case requires it; never equate those identifiers.

findings.title: The decision Command receipt does not expose a reconstructable decision input
findings.finding: The prior decision-attempt entity records action/finalized-pattern hash. The console has a typed DecideApproval request, but its readable Command record exposes only operation/requestDigest/subjects and lifecycle; it has no retained request source or typed decision value.
findings.recommendation: Specify how an authorized historical audit resolves the exact submitted decision input from the Command. A typed owned intent value or exact request-source reference is sufficient; a standalone version entity is not required.

findings.title: Peripheral native resources are represented only by retained source profiles
findings.finding: Each native resource has an explicit source profile and preserves identity/lifecycle vocabulary, but none has a normalized dedicated model or complete product capability. Homonyms are correctly kept separate from workload Service, resilience Recommendation, console Scenario and Connection.
findings.recommendation: Count these as retained resource representations, not normalized entity coverage or implemented AWS integration. Promote a resource only after its domain use case and lifecycle authority justify that model/API surface.

findings.title: SnapshotProjection crosswalk wording uses obsolete target field names
findings.finding: The preservation note still says imported legacy renditions are pinned in sourceRevisionIds, although the current Snapshot contract uses members of exact EntityRef(kind,id,version).
findings.recommendation: Use sourceRevisionIds/projectionRevisionId only when naming old source vocabulary; describe current bindings as Snapshot.members with exact Source or Projection versions.

findings.title: Native Task normalization selects one task discriminator
findings.finding: The pinned native Task catalog includes INVESTIGATION, EVALUATION, RELEASE_READINESS_REVIEW and RELEASE_TESTING. The normalized Investigation contract deliberately describes the INVESTIGATION facet only; other types are retained native task documents.
findings.recommendation: Keep the Investigation concept normalized and report the broader native Task family as partial. Add another domain facet only for a supported use case, rather than pretending all task types are Investigations.
